# Psalm 97 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 97:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Have-lit-up his-lightnings the-world; has-seen and-trembles the-earth.
- **LOGOS:** His lightnings light up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
- **PNEUMA:** His lightning bolts illuminate the world; the earth sees it and trembles.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 97:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Have-declared the-heavens his-righteousness, and-have-seen all the-peoples his-glory.
- **LOGOS:** The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.
- **PNEUMA:** The heavens announce his righteousness, and every nation witnesses his glory.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 97:12 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Be-glad O-righteous in-YHWH, and-give-thanks to-memory-of his-holiness.
- **LOGOS:** Rejoice in the LORD, O you righteous, and give thanks to his holy name!
- **PNEUMA:** Celebrate the LORD, all you who live right! Give thanks as you remember his holiness!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 97:7 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** Are-ashamed all servants-of carved-images, those-boasting in-the-nothings; bow-down to-him all gods.
- **LOGOS:** All worshipers of images are put to shame, who make their boast in worthless idols; worship him, all you gods!
- **PNEUMA:** Everyone who worships idols is put to shame — those who brag about their worthless gods. Even the 'gods' bow down before him!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** Clouds and thick darkness are all around him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
- **PNEUMA:** Clouds and deep darkness surround him, but righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** Light is-sown for-the-righteous, and-for-the-upright-of heart gladness.
- **LOGOS:** Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
- **PNEUMA:** Light shines like seeds planted for the righteous, and joy for those whose hearts are honest.
